name: Dice & Destiny
tagline: The rules of the realm, made whole.
adds: Fights, checks and conditions by the 2024 Player's Handbook: advantage, the fifteen conditions, exhaustion, surprise, grappling and shoving, Heroic Inspiration
The creatures already in the world, re-made from the 2025 Monster Manual
Enemies that think: they focus, protect their casters, use every trick they have, and spend their magic when the fight matters
Reactions that ask you first: Shield, opportunity attacks and the rest
Treasure and hoards by the Dungeon Master's Guide, and magic items with charges, attunement and curses
Artifacts with powers and flaws of their own in every world, and old things that are awake and have opinions
Bands sized by the Dungeon Master's Guide, a travel pace to choose, and moods: not every band wants a fight
A small icon for every state, and a card for anything you point at in a fight
This shelf of expansions on the main menu
